title: Capacity planner
idea: Capacity planner: Demand and staffed capacity share a reviewable allocation form
audience: People who need to allocate capacity within a dashboard surface.
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic decision layout through its allocate capacity priority and explicit commitment contract: Save only validated non-conflicting allocations
navigation: Capacity planner keeps the current allocate capacity context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: Demand and staffed capacity share a reviewable allocation form
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to allocate capacity; scheduling depends on finite resources

imagery.role: Support the actual allocate capacity context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Keep units and conflicts visible when charts collapse
Keep units, filters and selection understandable at narrow widths; expose a focused item view.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the capacity planner structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no allocate capacity content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Save only validated non-conflicting allocations
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized allocate capacity content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active allocate capacity context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure bounded queries and large-data interaction; virtualize only with accessible alternatives.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate with browser study renders. Automated browser checks are recorded in evals/specimen-review.json. No independent visual comparison, task study or native runtime verification; remains draft. The illustration/task content demonstrates composition and does not prescribe every linked palette or font.
